about: Each Sync* UB site the workloads in sync::miri_ub_sites reach, per Miri check. `ub` pins the error phrase and the innermost frame of the lowest failing seed; `clean` means every seed in the range passed. Checked nightly by scripts/miri_ub_sites.py --check; a fix flips an entry to `clean` by an explicit edit.
